limits: Same-release full geometry does not establish legal authority or historic watercourse location.
The source subject IDs and properties remain source assertions; no current crosswalk or territorial assignment is inferred.
A positive geometric intersection does not identify the cause of a gap or whether it was water, land, or a historic channel.

method.area_units: square degrees; not a physical area measure
method.coordinate_operations: No projection, snapping, buffering, simplification, normalization, repair or MakeValid
method.overlay: Shapely/GEOS predicates, overlay and unary union on unmodified source GeoJSON EPSG:4326 coordinates
method.source_scan: STRtree predicate scan over all 109 NAM and 161 AGO full product features for each component
method.subject_matrix: All 21 original components x all 10 source contact subjects, 210 rows
